entry.title: Updated: dsh-git-status
entry.summary: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes. Exact install spec: @wongzexu/dsh-git-status. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
